pot-odds: Pot odds calculator. Props: pot_bb (pot before the bet), bet_bb.
outs: Outs calculator: exact next-card and two-card chances vs the rule of 2 and 4. Props: outs, unseen.
combos: Combination counter with card removal (range engine). Props: range, dead.
bet-math: Alpha, MDF and bluff ratio for one bet, with EV lines. Props: pot_bb, bet_bb.
regret-matching: Regret matching on rock-paper-scissors (toy game). Props: iterations, start_regrets.
equity: Equity of two hands or ranges (equity engine). Props: hands (list), board.
question: Embeds one of the lesson's knowledge-check questions. Props: id.
